newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS Holding to sell Watt for one bln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: CS Holding to sell Watt for one bln Sfr.

text.p: Swiss financial group CS Holding said it expected to sell its stake in Swiss energy group Watt AG for around one bilion Swiss francs.

"The (sales) price is slightly over the book value of the entire Elektrowatt stake of one billion francs," CS Holding's chairman Rainer Gut told a news conference, when asked about the price CS Holding would get for selling its 44.9 percent stake in Watt.
Elektrowatt announced earlier this month that it would spin-off its energy activities into Watt.
Gut added that negotiations to sell CS Holding's stake in the industrial part of Elektrowatt were in "an advanced stage" and an announcement could be expected early next year.
An earlier announcement, however, could not be excluded.
"The holidays are not upon us, but who knows," Gut said.
